modes.fastboot: Power off. Hold Volume Down + Power until the FASTBOOT screen shows, then plug in USB.

unlock.text: Unlocked bootloader needed: `fastboot flashing unlock` (wipes the phone).
steps: Back up everything. Unlocking erases the phone.
Settings › About phone: tap Build number 7 times to turn on Developer options.
Settings › System › Developer options: OEM unlocking on.
Power off, then hold Power + Volume Down for fastboot mode. On a computer run `fastboot flashing unlock`, pick Unlock with the volume keys and press Power. The phone wipes and restarts.
Back in fastboot mode, the flasher checks `unlocked: yes` itself before writing anything. Go to step 2.

pivots.fix: Fastboot mode (Power + Volume Down) still works. Section R (Recover / revert) restores Xiaomi stock.

hints: Android One phone: no Mi Unlock app and no waiting period, `fastboot flashing unlock` is enough.
OEM unlocking stays grey until the phone has been online once: connect to Wi-Fi for a minute.
Charge to at least 50 % and use a data USB cable.

recovery.text: Quick way: slot a still holds stock Android: `fastboot set_active a`, then `fastboot -w`. Full restore: the stock package below.
